panel: Claude Sonnet 5 (Claude Code), sesion pensive-blackwell-9a9f45, 2026-09-16 -- revision manual linea por linea de bin/bb contra SPEC.md Risks table (SPEC-L93..L97); SPEC-L93 corregido en el mismo commit tras hallar sobre-alcance real (3 de ~13 checks son por dato, el resto por unit-active); ledger sellado en el primer release commit (declaracion de version) tras amend deliberado (decision de Luis 2026-09-16, override del precedente anti-rewrite 3c0f416)

results.evidence: bin/bb cmd_status (lines ~1295-1373): confirmed mtime-based `find ... -mmin` freshness checks for sar (sysstat, <10min), memory-monitor.log (<10min) and Atlas telemetry (<2min), the latter carrying the explicit comment 'Por sus datos, no por la unit'. Also confirmed the remaining checks (blackbox-sample.timer, atom-clock-lock.service, earlyoom.service) use `systemctl is-active`, not data freshness -- the SPEC.md Risks-table line originally claimed this as bb status's general behavior, which overstated coverage. Corrected SPEC.md line 93 today (2026-09-16) to name the 3-check subset accurately and name the unclosed gap in the other 3 checks instead of implying blanket coverage.

bin/bb: cannot_run() (line 43) increments a global CNR counter and appends to CNR_LIST on every could-not-run path inside cmd_scan (13 call sites: kernel OOM, Xid, GPU accounting, xHCI, coredumps, MemFree min, net/CPU rates, thermal events, margin warnings, PSI, process disappearances). cmd_scan prints 'comprobaciones que NO pudieron correr: $CNR' and, when CNR>0, 'Este informe NO esta limpio: $CNR comprobaciones no llegaron a ejecutarse' (lines ~1224-1228). Matches the claim: a check that cannot fail is counted and the report explicitly refuses to call itself clean.

systemd/blackbox-sample.service (the unit that runs `bb sample`) declares Nice=19 and IOSchedulingClass=idle verbatim, matching the claim exactly. cmd_sample() (bin/bb lines 246-320) reads only /proc/meminfo, /proc/loadavg, /proc/pressure/*, /proc/net/dev, /proc/stat, /proc/<pid>/cgroup, plus pre-existing local endpoints the gateway/docker already expose (curl to 127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models and /metrics, `docker ps`) -- no new monitoring endpoint or subprocess-heavy sampling is introduced.

bin/bb lines 1051-1054: explicit comment 'Los umbrales son PROVISIONALES: vienen de la escala LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL de esa fuente [sparkview, foro NVIDIA 366877], NO de una medicion propia en esta maquina. Cuando haya suficientes muestras habra que calibrarlos contra un incidente real.' The PSI section header itself is printed as '-- presion del kernel (PSI, umbrales provisionales) --'. Matches the claim verbatim in substance.

bin/bb cmd_drift() (lines 1504-1537): cmp_one() does a byte-for-byte `cmp -s` between each deployed file and its repo copy across gpu_governance/, systemd-user/ and system-config/, printing 'igual' on match, 'DIVERGE' with a unified diff on mismatch, and 'AUSENTE' when the deployed file is gone -- textually matches 'compara repo contra maquina'. I re-ran `bash bin/bb drift` live on 2026-09-16 (not a synthetic test) and it produced all three verdicts in one real run against the actual machine state: 13 files 'igual', 2 'DIVERGE' (atom-crash-detector.service, atom-gpu-telemetry.service -- real unsynced drift, committed to the repo 2026-09-11 but never redeployed, flagged separately as its own follow-up task since it's live operational debt, not an audit defect), 1 'AUSENTE' (gpu_sampler.sh, which is the documented 2026-09-07 suspension in suspended/MANIFIESTO.md, not a bug). This organically demonstrates both directions the acceptance criterion asks for (says yes when there is a difference, says no when there isn't), on real data rather than a staged before/after. I could not locate any test file, CI job, or changelog entry recording a prior deliberate introduce-then-restore test session for bb drift specifically (tests/ contains only test_check_harvest_accepted.py), so the SPEC wording 'se verifico' as a claim about a specific past testing event is not independently confirmable from repo artifacts -- what I can confirm is that the mechanism is correct and bidirectional as observed live today.
